new_canonical_source.dimension_policy: read DDS header; do not trust _WIDTHxHEIGHT suffix

migration_rules: Match assets by stable hexadecimal hash prefix, not the old resolution suffix.
Prefer the highest actual DDS dimensions from the installed HD texture tree.
Preserve the HD mod's artwork, alpha, DDS format, mip behavior, sprite orientation and cell geometry.
Re-render Korean graphics against the HD source; do not upscale old Korean DDS candidates.
Previously approved stock-resolution Korean DDS remain historical evidence only until revalidated/rebuilt against HD source.
No new graphics promotion while the HD source archive identity is pending.
